svg.text: Blank 1,016 x 916 x 1 mm, the same outside size as the deck frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut four openings 474 x 414, one under each tray bed: their edges

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 15 and 489 east and west of the centre line, 15 and 429 north and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: south of the centre line. Drill 10 mm in the corners, cut between

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a jigsaw and file straight.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rivet to the deck frame along the bar centre lines at 150 pitch;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: no rivet falls where a tray lip sits.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
